description: This file defines the CancelledAuditActionService class, which handles audit actions related to cancellations, including versioning, data parsing, migration, and display logic for cancellation events in booking audits.

classes.name: CancelledAuditActionService
classes.description: Implements IAuditActionService to manage cancellation audit actions with versioning, data validation, and display functionalities.

methods.name: getVersionedData
methods.description: Returns versioned data based on input fields.

methods.name: parseStored
methods.description: Parses stored data to extract fields.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version number from data.

methods.name: migrateToLatest
methods.description: Validates and migrates data to the latest schema version.

methods.name: getDataRequirements
methods.description: Returns data requirements, here an empty list of user UUIDs.

methods.name: getDisplayTitle
methods.description: Returns the display title key for the cancellation action.

methods.name: getDisplayJson
methods.description: Generates display data for the cancellation event, including reason, user, and status changes.
